description: Replace the notes on a finished Load Test's Test Report — the only thing on a Load Test this surface edits. Ask the user before writing: notes belong to the user, and advising on a test never requires writing them. The text sent becomes the report's entire notes, so first read the current notes with get_load_test_report and preserve the user's content in what you send.

loadTestId.description: The load test id, as reported by list_load_tests. Required unless the deprecated testId is sent.

notes.description: The full notes text to store on the Test Report, replacing whatever notes it already carries. At most 4096 characters; an empty string clears the notes.

testId.description: Deprecated alias of loadTestId; send loadTestId instead.

name: update_load_test_notes
title: Update Load Test Notes
